hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set +x powershell.exe -Command '$s=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:8080/JspApp/index.jsp" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; $s.Stop(); $t=$s.ElapsedMilliseconds; if ($t -lt 1000) { Write-Host "Status: $($r.StatusCode) $($r.StatusDescription) | Time: ${t}ms | State: UP (Optimal)" -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 } else { Write-Host "Status: $($r.StatusCode) $($r.StatusDescription) | Time: ${t}ms | State: UP (SLOW)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 0 } } catch { Write-Host "Status: FAILED / DOWN | Error: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }'
